independence_guard.rule: critic_one writes a family's two decisions into each unit's order-1 packet folder (decisions.json), which is also a decider's working folder, and removes it after the critic. No critic may run while a decider of the other family can still run, and the two families' critics never run together.
independence_guard.observed: The last decision of either family finished at 10:29:12Z (Claude); the first critic started at 10:29:38Z (GPT); the Claude critics started only after the GPT critics had exited (11:26:31Z). Adjudicators work in a folder of their own per adjudication.

web_evidence.allowed: both families: Claude judges had WebSearch and WebFetch; GPT judges ran codex exec with web_search=live through the OmniRoute gateway

claude.note: Claude Code runs WebSearch (and WebFetch processing) through a helper model, claude-haiku-4-5; the judge model's own server-side search counter stays 0. The search results themselves are not in the retained envelopes.

gpt.cause: the gateway's search route has no credentialed search provider and falls back to a keyless provider that returned nothing from this host (docs/decisions/2026-10-02-omniroute-mac-rebuild.md, Limits)

web_evidence.consequence: The two families had the same dossiers and source clones, but not the same live web evidence: the Claude judges could consult web results, the GPT judges in effect could not. Agreement between the families rests on the shared dossiers and clones; where they differed, this asymmetry is one possible factor.

adjudicator_anonymity: Adjudicators saw the two families' critic returns as A and B in both orders. A return's text can still name contenders whose names coincide with the families (claude-code, codex and similar) or carry a family's style; the returns were not audited one by one for such signals.

usage_provider_returned.note: Sums of the usage each call returned. A lower bound: attempts whose records were deleted after a usage-limit stop are not counted, and the coordinator's own usage and the separate repair workflow are outside these figures.

usage_limit_stops: Claude session limits stopped the dossier stage on 2026-10-02 at about 04:40Z, 19:46Z and 22:03Z and on 2026-10-03 at about 02:26Z and 05:00Z, and the Claude decide stage at 08:29Z.

orchestration: Wrappers outside this folder started the frozen runner after a usage reset, stopped it when three or more records failed within ten seconds, ordered the stages as above, and deleted records without a result. They changed no prompt, model, tool, schema or decision.
